## Problem

Describe the concrete issue or user need.

## Change

Explain the resulting behavior and relevant tradeoffs.

## Validation

List checks actually performed. Include physical-device results for camera, audio, Core ML or AR changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Credentials, local configuration and private records are excluded.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behavior.
- [ ] Unknown measurements remain distinct from passing checks.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or limitations are explicitly described.
